note: Recorded requirements for module VER (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: Verification checklist for the nodal officer
requirements.description: The system shall show the institution nodal officer each application with its documents, DigiLocker verification status and the results of business rules BR-001 to BR-004, and require each checklist item to be marked before the application can be verified.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an application with one checklist item unmarked, when the nodal officer tries to verify it, then the system blocks the action and highlights the item.

requirements.title: Bulk sanction by the District Social Welfare Officer
requirements.description: The system shall allow the District Social Welfare Officer to sanction up to 100 verified applications together after reviewing the list, recording each sanction individually in the audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Given 40 verified applications selected, when the DSWO sanctions them together, then 40 individual sanction entries appear in the audit trail.
